statements.text: I introduced HR 4162, the Land Grant Research Prioritization Act -a bill that would provide land grant universities w/ dedicated access to existing USDA grant funding to enhance AI & mechanization solutions to the challenges facing America’s ag producers.https://t.co/XKTXMvMGGe

We must ensure that we are on the cutting edge of technology that can assist our farmers and producers. [...] I am pleased to work with Congressman Franklin through this legislation to harness the power of our 1862 and 1890 land-grant institutions to explore how mechanized harvesting and artificial intelligence can help improve U.S. agriculture.
statements.venue: Press release on the Land Grant Research Prioritization Act (H.R. 4162)

statements.text:
Last Thursday, I met with the President of Albany State University, Dr. Robert Scott. We spoke about the changing environment of education due to new factors like artificial intelligence (AI), and how we can work together to adapt to this unprecedented moment. We also discussed the many research and teaching accomplishments of its departments and programs and how Albany, our state, and our country can benefit from and build off these achievements.

I will continue to work with Democrats and Republicans, including those on the bipartisan Congressional HBCU Caucus, to make sure we continue investing in university powerhouses like Albany State University and keep our country on the cutting edge of progress.

Yesterday, Rep. Franklin of FL and I reintroduced our bipartisan Land Grant Research Prioritization Act, H.R. 7734, which allows land grant institutions to apply for competitive USDA grants to support farm mechanization and agricultural artificial intelligence applications, invasive species and aquaculture research initiatives. This bill will help innovate and pioneer solutions to the challenges facing our country's agricultural producers.

https://t.co/4Gg29ivv0p

This week, I met with members of the Georgia State Council of Machinists. We discussed artificial intelligence (AI) and its possible effect on our workforce. As Congress tackles AI policy, I will continue to listen to my constituents and bring their perspectives to the debate and acknowledge how intricately AI affects our lives every day, from work and art to personal privacy and national security.

The development of AI has caused a real, real impact in terms of communities deciding whether they want to accommodate the data centers that support AI. It’s causing communities to have to make some very, very difficult decisions.
statements.venue: WALB News interview on data centers

statements.text: There are pros and cons with data centers. They promote investment… they increase tax bases… but they use a lot of energy, a lot of water… and communities have to weigh those tradeoffs.
statements.venue: WALB News interview on data centers

statements.text: My advice is to make sure that the officials that will make the decisions take into account the benefits and the detriments. [And] require that the data centers provide the community with assurances… that they will not have their rates increased inordinately… [and] that the community will receive something in return.
